title: 第二十八章 陪一晚？
content_zh:
这话要是放在以前，放在一个正常人身上，多少会让人觉得尴尬。

    可在这几个婆娘看来，王大壮就算脑子好了，大家都知根知底，开个玩笑也没什么。

    再说了，幸福村的男人们几乎都外出打工去了，留在村里的青壮年一只手都数得过来。

    这些婆娘们平日里独守空房，嘴上说说荤话解解闷，也是常有的事。

    陈春花听了这话，不但不恼，反而笑呵呵回应道：“人家大壮现在又不傻，我还能厚着脸皮晚上去窜门吗？再说了，就算我愿意，人家家里的李玉梅也不一定答应呀！”

    几个婆娘听了全都哈哈大笑起来，笑声在空旷的山坡上传得老远。

    王大壮站在路边，听着这些话，脸上没有半点羞涩，反而咧嘴一笑，大大方方道：“春花嫂要是愿意的话，我倒是可以给你留门，就怕到时候张三哥回来就说不清楚了。”

    这话说得有理有据，既没有得罪人，又把球踢了回去。

    几个婆娘全都愣住了，瞪大了眼睛看着王大壮，像是第一次认识他一样。

    “哎呀我的天！”张秀莲第一个反应过来，拍着大腿哈哈大笑，“你们听听，你们听听，大壮这嘴皮子，哪像是傻过的人？比咱们村里那些大老爷们儿都会说话！”

    刘桂香也笑得前仰后合起来，“可不是嘛，我估摸着啊，大壮这脑子不但好了，还比以前更精了！”

    陈春花也被王大壮这话噎了一下，但很快就笑了出来，指着王大壮道：“好你个大壮，现在嘴皮子利索了，学会拿嫂子开涮了是吧？”

    王大壮嘿嘿直笑，也不辩解。

    这时候，张秀莲忽然凑过来，用一种促狭的语气问道：“大壮，你跟嫂子说实话，是不是你嫂子在家教了你很多呀？怎么连这些话都知道？”

    王大壮看了她一眼，笑容不变道：“我嫂子的确教了我不少东西，包括怎么怼人。”

    这话说得滴水不漏，既没有否认，也没有承认，反而把几个婆娘逗得更乐了。

    “行了行了，不跟你们吹牛了，我得赶紧上山了，再晚天就热了。”王大壮摆了摆手，转身继续往山上走。

    身后传来几个婆娘的笑声和议论声，王大壮也不在意。

    走了没多远，身后忽然传来一阵急促的脚步声，紧接着是一声兴奋的犬吠。
content_en:
If this were said in the past, to a normal person, it would be somewhat embarrassing.

    But in the eyes of these women, even if Wang Dazhuang has a good mind, everyone knows the truth, so it's okay to make a joke.

    Besides, almost all the men in Xingfu Village have gone out to work, and the number of young and middle-aged men staying in the village can be counted on one hand.

    It is common for these women to stay alone in their empty rooms and talk about dirty things to relieve their boredom.

    After Chen Chunhua heard this, not only was she not annoyed, but she responded with a smile: "I am a strong man and I am not stupid now, how can I still have the shamelessness to break in at night? Besides, even if I am willing, Li Youmei at home may not agree!"

    The ladies all burst out laughing after hearing this, and their laughter spread far and wide on the empty hillside.

    Wang Dazhuang stood on the roadside, listening to these words, there was no shyness on his face. Instead, he grinned and said openly: "If Mrs. Chunhua is willing, I can open the door for you. I'm afraid that Brother Zhang will not be able to explain clearly when he comes back."

    This was reasonable and well-founded. It didn't offend anyone and kicked the ball back.

    The ladies were all stunned and looked at Wang Dazhuang with wide eyes, as if they were meeting him for the first time.

    "Oh my God!" Zhang Xiulian was the first to react, slapping her thighs and laughing, "Listen, listen, Da Zhuang is such a talkative person, how can he be stupid? He can talk better than those big men in our village!"

    Liu Guixiang also laughed so hard, "That's right, I guess, not only is Da Zhuang's brain better, he's even smarter than before!"

    Chen Chunhua was also choked by Wang Dazhuang's words, but she soon laughed out loud, pointed at Wang Dazhuang and said, "Well, you Dazhuang, you are so sharp-tongued now, you have learned how to tease your sister-in-law, right?"

    Wang Dazhuang laughed and did not defend himself.

    At this time, Zhang Xiulian suddenly came over and asked in a narrow tone: "Dazhuang, tell your sister-in-law the truth. Did your sister-in-law teach you a lot at home? How come you even know these words?"

    Wang Dazhuang glanced at her and said without changing his smile: "My sister-in-law did teach me a lot, including how to quarrel with others."

    This was said in a flawless manner, without denying or admitting it. On the contrary, it made several women even more amused.

    "Okay, okay, I won't brag to you anymore. I have to go up the mountain quickly. It will be hot in the evening." Wang Dazhuang waved his hand, turned around and continued walking up the mountain.

    The laughter and discussion of several women came from behind, but Wang Dazhuang didn't care.

    Not far away, there was suddenly a rush of footsteps behind him, followed by an excited bark.
